title: Eradicating Social Biases in Sentiment Analysis using Semantic Blinding and Semantic Propagation Graph Neural Networks
reasoning: The paper focuses on mitigating social biases (specifically political and gender bias) in sentiment analysis models using Graph Neural Networks and 'semantic blinding.' While it addresses fairness and includes ethical considerations for unbiased models, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, spiritual traditions, or specific moral/ethical philosophies.
